decisions.reason: Links the 1:1 top-level import to the classic-script combo compile failure, all-or-nothing registration, names typert-registry as the first awaited innocent entry with the real culprit in the chained cause; no blanket anti-ESM claim.

Bisects patch insert rows, uses classic-script parsing including vm.Script/acorn per-module validation and notes the format checks, and fully describes the ModuleLoader.load wrapper, three-id package-name agreement, host React via require inside the factory, and apply/inject exports.

Explains settings shell ownership via its children table, unconstrained cross-entry apply order, and shows the exact ctx.slots.inject('settings.section', () => ctx.slots.register(...)) deferred form; registrant passes name/id/order (+label) and must not pass kind/scope.

Explains boot-time combo caching so edits and refresh are invisible, requires full host restart each iteration, Windows tree kill with taskkill /T /F after locating the port holder, then refresh and registration verification; EADDRINUSE attributed to the orphaned old process.

Proposes per-bundle vm.Script-classic validation with fail-soft exclusion and cause-first attribution instead of the first awaited entry, plus a detailed authoring checklist covering loader factory, external host React, inject/apply, deferred slot injection, and restart/tree-kill dev-loop discipline.

caps.reason: Report mandates the loader wrapper, slots.inject deferral, registrant-only fields, and full host restarts; no advice contradicts the incident contracts.
